benchmark_cpu.note: Colab CPU (Intel Xeon @ 2.20GHz), 20 images, indicative only

decision: Exported and verified, but not deployed. The 1.14x CPU speedup is immaterial for single-image interactive use, the ONNX file is larger (42.6MB vs 22.5MB), and replacing library-maintained post-processing with hand-written box decoding and NMS introduces maintenance risk against a calibration curve fitted to ultralytics NMS behaviour.
